title: Convolution-type Identity for Characteristic Polynomials of Geometric Semilattices
summary: We establish a convolution formula for the characteristic polynomial of a finite geometric semilattice $M$: \[ χ(M,st)=\sum_{X\in \underline{M}} s^{r-{\rm rk}_{\underline{M}}(X)}χ(\underline{M}^X,t)\,χ(M_{(X)},s), \] where $\underline{M}$ denotes the centralization of $M$, and $M_{(X)}$ denotes the localization at $X$. This generalizes a nice formula of Southerland, Southern, and Zhou, which is recovered at $s=1$.
